title: Minimizing the volume of globally hyperbolic anti-de Sitter 3-manifolds
summary: In this paper we show that the volume of a maximal globally hyperbolic Cauchy-compact anti-de Sitter $3$-manifold $M$ is at least $π^2|χ(M)|$, and that this minimum value is attained if and only if $M$ is Fuchsian.
